title: Breadcrumb kit
description: Route-derived breadcrumbs with ellipsis menu and copy URL.

"use client"

import dynamic from "next/dynamic"

import { BreadcrumbsSkeleton } from "./breadcrumb-breadcrumb-skeleton"

export const Breadcrumbs = dynamic(() => import("./breadcrumb-breadcrumb").then((mod) => mod.Breadcrumbs), {
	ssr: false,
	loading: () => <BreadcrumbsSkeleton />,
})

"use client" import { CheckIcon, CopyIcon, HomeIcon, LinkIcon, SlashIcon } from "lucide-react" import Link from "next/link" import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation" import { useTranslations } from "next-intl" import { Fragment, useState } from "react" import { toast } from "sonner" import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator, } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu" import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import type { SearchParamsLike } from "./breadcrumb-breadcrumb-utils" import { compressBreadcrumbs, generateBreadcrumbs, hasHidden, isExternalOrPortalHome, resolveHomeHref, } from "./breadcrumb-breadcrumb-utils" import { slugToTitle } from "./breadcrumb-url-utils" type BreadcrumbsProps = { className?: string | undefined /** Optional locale prefix for the home crumb (e.g. `en` → `/en`). */ locale?: string | undefined /** Override pathname for docs and tests; defaults to `usePathname()`. */ pathname?: string | undefined /** Override search params when using `pathname`. */ searchParams?: SearchParamsLike | null | undefined /** `header` hides below `md` (dashboard shell). `inline` always shows (docs, mobile nav). */ display?: "header" | "inline" | undefined } export function Breadcrumbs({ className, locale, pathname: pathnameProp, searchParams: searchParamsProp, display = "header", }: BreadcrumbsProps) { const t = useTranslations() const pathnameFromRouter = usePathname() const searchParamsFromRouter = useSearchParams() const pathname = pathnameProp ?? pathnameFromRouter const searchParams = searchParamsProp ?? searchParamsFromRouter const homeHref = resolveHomeHref(locale) const { visible: breadcrumbs } = compressBreadcrumbs(generateBreadcrumbs(pathname, searchParams)) const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false) const handleCopyUrl = async () => { const toastId = toast.loading(t("breadcrumb.copyingUrl")) try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href) setCopied(true) window.setTimeout(() => { setCopied(false) }, 2000) toast.success(t("breadcrumb.urlCopied"), { id: toastId }) } catch { toast.error(t("breadcrumb.copyFailed"), { id: toastId }) } } const homeLink = isExternalOrPortalHome(homeHref) ? ( {t("common.home")} ) : ( {t("common.home")} ) return ( {homeLink} {t("breadcrumb.portalHome")} {breadcrumbs.map((node, index) => { const isLast = index === breadcrumbs.length - 1 const isEllipsis = node.label === "..." return ( {isEllipsis ? ( {t("breadcrumb.hiddenLinks")} {hasHidden(node) && node.hidden.map((crumb) => ( {slugToTitle(crumb.label)} ))} ) : null} {!isEllipsis && isLast ? ( {slugToTitle(node.label)} {t("breadcrumb.currentPage")} ) : null} {!isEllipsis && !isLast ? ( {slugToTitle(node.label)} {t("breadcrumb.goTo", { label: slugToTitle(node.label) })} ) : null} ) })} {t("breadcrumb.copyUrl")} ) }

export * from "./breadcrumb-breadcrumb-import"
export * from "./breadcrumb-breadcrumb-skeleton"
export * from "./breadcrumb-breadcrumb-utils"
export * from "./breadcrumb-url-utils"
